picos-de-europa-desfiladero-loop.title: Picos de Europa · Desfiladero Loop
picos-de-europa-desfiladero-loop.slogan: Two passes and 228 km, high point 1609 m
picos-de-europa-desfiladero-loop.story: The Picos pack alpine scale into a short distance from the Atlantic. The Desfiladero de los Beyos threads a narrow gorge for kilometres, and the climb to the Covadonga lakes is steep, narrow and sometimes access-restricted in high season. Check that restriction before riding up.
